context:
Goal: each repo's page is usable live and rebuildable anywhere, with git as the dataset.
Problem (rule): decision waiting-data-in-repo says git is each artifact's home and the claude.ai link is one account's view of it. Your item 593 a (12:40 CST Nov 12) says the page's database is the one store and git a timely backup; #2829 builds that. They differ on which is the truth. As built, git lags the database (measured 12:40 CST Nov 12: 519 items in git, 577 on the page), and page.html reads only the database.
Based on (ruling): waiting-data-in-repo, 2026-11-02 14:58 CST.
Based on (ruling): item 593 a, 2026-11-12 12:40 CST.
Based on (relayed): your 12:03 CST Nov 13 words, as the retrospective quotes them: "nothing points to a specific link of the artifact as the real dataset, only git data in a sense".
Departs from: main — the database is the store and git is copied at each wake; a makes git the truth and the database a live cache.
Meanwhile: #2829 is out of batch 136 and stays a draft; the three-fix follow-up step waits too.
home: PR #2829; rulings R28 and item 593 a

options.gain: Rebuildable anywhere; cross-account reads need nothing special; no stale copy.
options.how: Every page write also lands in git at once or within the turn; the page builds from git. This follows waiting-data-in-repo and your 12:03 CST words.
options.label: Git is the truth; the database is a live cache (recommended)
options.lose: Every answer costs a git write, and 593 a is partly overturned.

options.how: #2829 rejoins the next batch; git is copied at each wake.
options.label: The database is the one store; git a timely backup (593 a, #2829 as built)
options.lose: Git lags, the Questions tab cannot render from git, and the cross-account gap needs the follow-up fixes.

reply: Closed as ruled, not asked: decision waiting-data-in-repo (your 14:56 and 14:58 CST Nov 2 words) already says git is each artifact's home and the claude.ai link is one account's view; 593 a fits it on timing (a timely export, not real time). #2829's sentence that the database is the one store contradicts the Nov 2 ruling, so it is rewritten: git home, database the live view. Ruling page-git-is-home. Coordinator and retrospective 12:08 CST Nov 13. Say so here if you want it otherwise.
short: Page data: git home or database?

shown.label: Git is the truth; the database is a live cache (recommended)
The database is the one store; git a timely backup (593 a, #2829 as built)

title: Which of your two rulings stands for a page's data: git is the home, or the database is the one store?
why: Two of your rulings word it differently, and #2829 is held until you say which stands.
